review_candidates.description_excerpt: Leapswitch Networks is seeking a skilled and proactive L2/L3 Network Engineer to design, implement, troubleshoot, and manage a highly available and secure network infrastructure spanning multiple technologies and vendors across colocated datacenter environments. Required Skills & Qualifications 8+ years of hands-on enterprise networking experience. Proven expertise with Cisco IOS / NX-OS and FortiOS.
